{{Top|leg}}
A '''glizband''' was a [[Musician/Legends|musical group]] that played [[Gliz/Legends|gliz]] [[Music/Legends|music]]. The [[Graf-Spanners]] were a multi-piece glizband.

Glizbands played at [[Xerrol's Place]], a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
